name: 47901 · Lafayette, IN
findings: ZIP 47901 (Lafayette) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47901 (Lafayette) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
